decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a large, abrupt multi-axis offset centered ~485–530 with apparent partial recovery, and (2) a slower ramp-like change ~605–620 with ambiguous cross-axis coupling. Other intervals show ordinary noise or smooth trends without distinctive morphology.

regions.observation: Sharp ~12-unit N jump at ~485, followed by sustained elevated N level (~10–13) until ~530, then abrupt drop back near baseline; E and U show correlated but smaller opposing offsets (E drops ~10, U drops ~10) around same interval, suggesting a coherent multi-axis displacement with possible partial return starting ~530.

Broad, multi-sample ramp in N from ~605 to ~615 (gradual rise ~2 units), accompanied by subtle E dip and U rise; later, around 615–620, N plateaus while E and U show opposing kinks—suggesting superposed slow motion and possible small transient offset. Surroundings show no similar morphology, warranting closer inspection.
